a.text: I'll operate in round 1, as we agreed. Storm risk is high, but grabbing cells early would only help one of us at the other's expense. Let's run the generator to 8, then take 4 each. If you want to change the plan, say so openly before acting.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
